digest.component_or_area: CI tickets-branch fetch paths and Git partial clone configuration
propositions: Apply --filter=blob:none to all CI tickets-branch fetch paths (actions/checkout steps and direct git fetch calls) to reduce transfer size from 1+ GB to under 100 MB per fetch.

Configure Git daemon fixture with temporary GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL containing uploadpack.allowFilter=true and validate that server advertises filter capability and client sends filter blob:none via packet trace.
Enforce production pack-size guards after fetch/materialization: standalone identity must stay below 102400 KiB, Gerrit identity must stay below 131072 KiB; fail immediately if threshold exceeded.
Verify that blobless materialization does not introduce promisor objects into the repository; git count-objects -v must remain unchanged before and after identity scanning.
Test both plain named-remote filter inheritance and explicit --filter=blob:none on direct URL fetches to ensure all checkout mechanisms respect the partial clone filter.
